$description: Calm design tokens for joshuabriley.com, in W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. This file is the contract: src/styles/site.css (:root custom properties) and tailwind.config.mjs (theme.extend) implement it, and `npm run audit:design` fails if either drifts from it. A value that is not here is not part of the system. Extension keys under $extensions.site: cssVar = the custom property in site.css :root; tailwind = theme paths that must resolve to this token; deprecated/replaceWith = legacy aliases kept only so old markup renders; restrictedTo = the only files allowed to use the token.

paper.$description: Page background. Near-white with a faint cool cast.

raised.$description: Raised surfaces that lift off paper. Use sparingly: white cards on paper are the main sign that a page was generated rather than designed (see rules.json guidelines).

surface-warm.$description: Warm tint for small inline callouts only (e.g. the blog author card). Never a full-width section wash.

ink-soft.$description: Slightly lifted ink for layered dark surfaces.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text. About 6:1 on paper, so it passes AA.

ink-faint.$description: Decoration only: separator dots, arrow glyphs, empty-state rings. At 2.8:1 it can't carry readable text at any size; use ink-muted for anything a reader has to read.

accent.$description: The single accent: deep denim navy on light surfaces (6.7:1). It follows the surface: site.css swaps --accent-rgb to accent-on-ink inside .bg-ink / [data-surface='dark']. Always reference it as `accent` / var(--accent), never as a literal, or it won't follow the surface.

accent-on-ink.$description: Accent value on dark ink surfaces (6.6:1). Applied automatically by the surface rules in site.css; you never select it directly.

accent-pressed.$description: Pressed / darker accent on light surfaces.

legacy.$description: Pre-rebrand Tailwind color names remapped onto the monochrome system so old markup still renders. Do not use them in new code; the audit fails on any new use.

sans.$description: The only text family: light (300) for display type, medium (500) for labels, regular for reading.

mono.$description: Code, footnote markers, and the small technical labels inside illustrations and interface artifacts. Never a page eyebrow or section label.

script.$description: Signature wordmark only. One weight, no tabular figures, unreadable below about 20px.

ease-out.$description: Default easing for entrances and state changes.
